browserDefectEvidence: Parent-reported Chrome v191: Button34 idle name exact match 0; Button25 idle and error exact name matches 0 while visible role=status text exists. This candidate has not yet received Chrome AX verification.
fallback: When neither non-null aria-labelledby nor non-null aria-label is supplied, a stable React.useId ID on the original role=status text is referenced from button aria-labelledby. Its current ReactNode determines the browser name.
priority: Non-null caller aria-labelledby is passed unchanged, including an empty string or a missing target. Existing caller aria-label is also passed unchanged. Browser native accessible-name precedence applies; no generated target is substituted.
If aria-labelledby is null or undefined and aria-label is non-null, no generated aria-labelledby is written; caller aria-label is passed unchanged, including an empty string.

If aria-labelledby and aria-label are both null or undefined (including omitted), the generated fallback relationship is used. Null and undefined mean an absent React DOM attribute, not a requested blank string.

Empty strings remain caller intent. They suppress the relevant fallback and may produce an empty browser name. Caller-supplied invalid ID references are not silently repaired. The host owns a meaningful explicit name.
content: children and each status label remain ReactNodes rendered once in the same live span. No flattening, stringification, cloning, hidden duplicate, fixed Chinese label, or ReactNode mount replacement is added.

status.liveNotification: Original role=status and aria-live=polite remain on the same text node. Actual AT announcement quality is unverified.
status.explicitNames: Explicit caller names remain stable through status changes; the visible/live feedback changes independently.

unchanged: No public props, type declarations, CSS, business behavior or other component implementation changed.
Native disabled/readOnly/aria-disabled, forwarded refs and metadata rerender node stability remain governed by the old contract.
Button25 remains the source's fixed 1000ms Math.random() > 0.5 demonstration.

Button34 calls the same navigator.clipboard.writeText text only on uncancelled activation; duplicate pending calls remain blocked; only fulfillment changes to copied; missing API, insecure context, sync throw, invalid return or rejection remain errors.
Successful feedback stays 2000ms. Reset/text/lock/unmount cancellation, latest callbacks and callback exception behavior are unchanged. Issued OS writes cannot be undone.
Clipboard bridge discrepancy is unresolved; no API replacement or fabricated actual success is introduced.
